coordinate frame

  • CURIE: gmeow:coordinateFrame
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coordinateFrame
  • Category: property

Relates a set of coordinates to the reference frame they are expressed in.

Property shape: object property; gmeow:SpatialCoordinates -> gmeow:ReferenceFrame; functional Sub-property of: gmeow:hasReferenceFrame

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:coordinateFrame from gmeow:SpatialCoordinates to gmeow:ReferenceFrame when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
